primary_endpoint: Participants with hepatic histological improvement in NAS at 12 months (360 days).
efficacy_outcome: Improvement occurred in 22 placebo participants versus 25, 27, and 34 participants receiving MSDC-0602K 62.5, 125, and 250 mg, respectively; p=0.747, 0.575, and 0.158 versus placebo.
safety_signal: Serious AEs: placebo 9/94 (1 death); MSDC-0602K 62.5 mg 5/99 (0 deaths), 125 mg 13/98 (1 death), and 250 mg 7/101 (0 deaths).
